subject.title: feat(clients): session groups, batch actions, inspector, and worktree-aware creation for native chat

question: Should maintainers sponsor this broad native-chat parity feature after the refresh defect is fixed and real macOS behavior proof is supplied?
rationale: The PR adds a substantial shared native-client capability under a protected maintainer label; implementation correctness alone cannot establish product acceptance or upgrade confidence.

options.title: Sponsor after focused repair and proof
options.body: Fix the full-list refresh regression, add redacted macOS runtime evidence, and continue normal review of the feature direction.

options.title: Narrow the parity scope
options.body: Retain only the session-management portion that maintainers want to support now and defer the remaining worktree or inspector surface.

options.title: Pause the feature direction
options.body: Close or defer the broad parity expansion if native session groups and advanced creation are not currently a product priority.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after focused repair and proof
recommendation.body: Fix the full-list refresh regression, add redacted macOS runtime evidence, and continue normal review of the feature direction.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work shows direct ownership of the native chat parity and session-management area.
